description.value: Foxglove Floral Cafe is a dual-concept business in Abbotsford combining a working florist shop with a cafe, opened in March 2024. The business also runs workshops, likely floral arranging, adding a creative dimension beyond the typical cafe stop. For a touring cyclist, it offers a distinctive rest point on Montrose Avenue in a commercial unit.
